Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on Support for Human Resources of Small and Medium Enterprises and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and matters necessary for their enforcement. [Amended on June 2, 2006.]
